tasks.title: Turns shown flat
tasks.request: My 6-year-old has a hard time following the 3D cube animations; create some options for a 2D, one-side view for the solution part
tasks.summary: Four mockups in the cmux browser; Max picked "slide, with After". The turn screens now show one side of the cube flat: the moving layer slides the way the arrow points, with small pictures of the side before and after the turn. The 3D cube stays on the start, check and done screens, and when I'm ready is tapped it turns to face the front and zooms into the flat side. Built on branch flat on 2026-11-06, not pushed yet.

items.note: The table behind the flat view: which side a turn is shown on, which row or column slides and which way. Checked against both cube models.

Draws the flat side with the arrow and the Before and After pictures, slides the moving layer (or rotates the side for a front turn), and no longer animates the 3D cube on the turn screens, and flies the 3D cube into the flat side when I'm ready is tapped.
The look of the flat side, its sliding layer window, the arrow overlay, the Before and After pictures and the top-of-the-cube tag.
The stage height became a variable the flat side sizes itself from; the old 3D arrow planes' styles are gone.
The stage holds the flat view's box next to the 3D scene.
Three new words in every language: Before, After, and Top of the cube for back-layer turns.
Proves the table right for all 27 turns of both cubes: only the layer moves on the shown side and it slides off the way the arrow points.
Every language's solve now checks the hold screen, the arrow, the sliding layer, the After picture, reduced motion and the back-turn tag.
The README's turn screenshot now shows the flat view.

tasks.title: Hidden random cube
tasks.request: A hidden cheat only I can do that fills all the cube colors randomly, and feasibly, in one click for easy testing
tasks.summary: Press and hold the Cube Coach brand for 3 seconds on a copying screen: the sides fill with a random real cube and the check begins. Not mentioned in the README.

items.note: Listens for the long press on the brand and calls the filler only on a copying screen; a tap or a short hold does nothing.
Scrambles a solved cube with its own turns, writes its sides into the copied colors and starts the check.
Holds the brand on both cube sizes and solves what appears; checks that a short hold and the welcome screen stay as they are.
